slides.title: Someone's coming over in 15 minutes. Here's the ADHD emergency reset.
slides.sub: Save this for the next doorbell panic

slides.title: Set a 15-minute timer first
slides.body: Not to rush you. To stop you from deep-cleaning the grout. The timer decides when we're done, not our brain.

slides.title: Only the rooms they'll see
slides.body: Entry, living room, bathroom. Close every other door. A closed door is a finished room today.

slides.title: Grab a laundry basket
slides.body: Walk through and toss every out-of-place thing in. Don't put anything away. Basket goes in the bedroom.

slides.title: Clear flat surfaces only
slides.body: Coffee table, counter, bathroom sink. Clear surfaces read as 'clean' even when the floor isn't perfect.

slides.title: Bathroom 3-step
slides.body: Fresh hand towel. Wipe the sink with whatever's there. Toilet lid down. That's the whole list.

slides.title: Last 2 minutes: light + smell
slides.body: Open a blind, turn on a lamp, light a candle or run the tap hot. Warm and bright beats spotless.

slides.title: Your guests are coming to see you, not to inspect your baseboards.
This is Day 0 of a full 7-day reset
slides.body: The emergency reset plus the whole shame-free 7-day plan is in The Messy Brain Home Reset ebook. Link in bio.
